PULSE Group Reporting: Slide content for a Portfolio/Program/End Item Config's combined status slide, and which member projects are currently included in its export deck — these groups are just name tags on individual projects, not their own SharePoint records, so this list is the one place to persist group-level Technical Status bullets, a formatted Description, a Risk Summary, extra ad-hoc milestones (beyond each member project's own Contract/FAT/SAT/etc. dates), the one photo (pulled from a member project's Photos tab) representing the config, and the deck's project inclusion selection.
